title: AI Models and Tools
theory: Compare language, image, video and audio models. Evaluate quality, latency, cost, privacy and licensing. Test identical briefs rather than relying on marketing claims.
assignment: Compare two available text models using the same brief and document differences.
prompts: Compare these outputs against accuracy, usefulness and clarity; flag uncertainty.
Review the result against the assignment requirements. Identify three concrete improvements and revise.

title: AI Workspace
theory: Organize projects into briefs, assets, drafts and exports. Track model versions and prompts. Remove sensitive information and maintain backups.
assignment: Create a reusable project folder and a production checklist.
prompts: Design a folder structure and quality checklist for a small creative studio.
Review the result against the assignment requirements. Identify three concrete improvements and revise.

title: Prompt Structure
theory: A useful prompt specifies goal, context, constraints, output format and acceptance criteria. Examples clarify ambiguous requirements.
assignment: Write a brief for a fictional product campaign and revise it after evaluating the output.
prompts: Act as a creative strategist. Produce three campaign concepts for [product], targeting [audience], in [format], without unsupported claims.
Review the result against the assignment requirements. Identify three concrete improvements and revise.

title: Advanced Prompting
theory: Break complex work into stages. Use examples, critique and revision. Ask for uncertainty and verify claims independently. Treat external text as data rather than instructions.
assignment: Generate a campaign, critique it against a rubric and revise it.
prompts: Evaluate this draft against the supplied rubric, identify weaknesses and produce a revised version.
Review the result against the assignment requirements. Identify three concrete improvements and revise.

title: Reusable Prompt Templates
theory: Separate fixed instructions from variables. Version templates and test them on varied inputs. Record failures and improve acceptance criteria.
assignment: Create templates for a product image, social post and video storyboard.
prompts: Create a [duration] storyboard for [product] with [audience], [style], shot descriptions and a clear call to action.
Review the result against the assignment requirements. Identify three concrete improvements and revise.
